nodes.description: Public state variable holding the contract owner address, initialized from msg.sender at deployment.
Public state variable recording the last completed migration index.
Public function restricted by the restricted modifier that writes the completed parameter into last_completed_migration.
Modifier that requires msg.sender to equal owner before executing the guarded body; the access-control gate of the contract.
msg.sender: used both to initialize owner and to pass the restricted modifier's ownership check.
State-modifying write last_completed_migration = completed, whose safety depends entirely on the restricted modifier's owner check.
Parameter of setCompleted controlling the value written into last_completed_migration.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned directly to the owner state variable at construction, so the owner identity derives from an untrusted caller-provided value.
msg.sender flows into the restricted modifier's ownership require check, which is the sole authorization gate.
owner state variable is read in the restricted modifier's require comparison msg.sender == owner, so a wrong or zeroed owner permanently weakens authorization.
The restricted modifier gates execution of setCompleted; if the ownership comparison is bypassable the function body becomes callable by anyone.
The completed parameter is supplied by the caller to setCompleted without any validation.
The completed parameter is the value written by the state-modifying operation.
Execution of setCompleted reaches and performs the state write operation.
The restricted modifier's require must pass before the state write executes, making the write's authorization dependent on msg.sender == owner.
The write operation mutates the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter exists only as the input argument of setCompleted and directly feeds its guarded state write; it should be collapsed into the setCompleted function node (and its unsafe_operation sink) rather than modeled as an independent graph node.
